entities.summary: Larry Ryan Squire is an American neuroscientist. He is a professor of psychiatry, neurosciences, and psychology at the University of California, San Diego, and a Senior Research Career Scientist at the Veterans Affairs Medical Center, San Diego. He is an investigator of the neurological bases of memory, which he studies using animal models and human patients with memory impairment.
